tinker.name: Process Killer
tinker.description: Process manager for viewing, searching, and killing processes

zh-CN.name: 进程清理
zh-CN.description: 进程管理，支持查看、搜索和终止进程

list.description: Refresh and list processes. Supports optional search query and view mode (cpu/memory/port). Returns pid, name, cpu, memory, user, ports, and path.

query.description: Optional search keyword matched against name, pid, user, or ports

view.description: Optional view mode. port only shows processes with listening ports. Defaults to the current UI view.

kill.description: Force-kill a process by pid. Skips the UI confirm dialog. Call list first to find the pid.
